title: Disputed Volume Over Time
note: resrisk-v2 · resdb-v2 · flags-v2 · cat-v1 · Bars are volume on markets contested at least once, bucketed by the month the contract closed. Line is the count of those markets. The final bucket is incomplete at the pull date and is flagged as partial. 17 disputed markets carry no close date: they are in the totals below and in no bar. Drawn from 58,623 observable markets. Dispute counts are Polymarket/UMA only, on the 58,623 markets that carry a UMA status sequence — Gamma populates it from 2025 onward. Kalshi exposes disputes as a transient market state with no retrospective filter, so its count here is a floor of zero, not a measurement of zero.
